title: Painda
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.item: Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chilli) powder
items.raw: Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chilli) powder 2 tsp
Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) ½ tbs or to taste
Namak (Salt) 1 & ½ tsp or to taste
Garam pani (Hot water) 1 litre or as required

steps.instruction: In spice mixer,add black cardamom,green cardamom,cumin seeds and grind well.
steps.romanUrdu: Spice mixer mein badi elaichi,hari elaichi aur zeera dal ker ache tarhan grind ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add garlic,ginger,green chillies,water and grind to make a paste & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Lehsan,adrak,hari micrh aur pani dal dein aur grind ker ka paste bana lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add coriander powder,Kashmiri red chilli powder,turmeric powder,garam masala powder,red chilli powder,mix well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein dhania powder,Kashmiri lal mirch powder,haldee powder,garam masala powder aur lal mirch powder dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add cooking oil,onion and fry until light golden.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein cooking oil aur pyaz dal dein aur light golden hunay tak fry ker lein.
Chicken dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add salt and mix well until changes color.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak dal dein aur rang tabdeel hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Now add spices & chilli paste,mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab spices & chilli paste dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 2-3 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add pureed tomatoes,mix well and cook on high flame for 6-8 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pureed tamatar dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur tez ancch per 6-8 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add yogurt and whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein dahi dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add yogurt and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein dahi dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Now add prepared spice mix,mix well and cook until oil separates.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab tayyar spice mix dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur oil alag hunay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add hot water,mix and bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: Garam pani dal ker mix karein aur ubal anay dein.
Aloo dal ker mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Cover partially and cook on low flame for 12-15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Partially dhak dein aur halki ancch per 12-15 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Switch off the flame,cover and let it rest for 5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Chulha bund ker dein aur dhak ker 5 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Take out tarri (oil) and add it in fresh coriander.
steps.romanUrdu: Tarri nikal lein aur hara dhania mein dal dein.

steps.instruction: In serving bowl,add roti,gravy and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Serving bowl mein roti aur gravy dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add chicken pieces and pour tarri.
steps.romanUrdu: Chicken pieces rakh ker upper sa tarri dal dein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with onion rings,tomato,lemon slices & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz rings,tamatar aur lemon slices sa garish ker ke serve karein.

ogDescription: A traditional dish in our signature way. Make painda today and enjoy. #HappyCookingToYou
